newsitem.title: CANADA: DUSA files IND for bladder cancer test.
newsitem.headline: DUSA files IND for bladder cancer test.

text.p: DUSA Pharmaceuticals Inc (DSP.TO said today it has filed an Investigational New Drug (IND) application with the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to begin a Phase 1/11 multicenter clinical trial to test Levulan (ALA) Photodetection (PD) for the detection of bladder cancer in high-risk patients.
The seven-center study involves 60 patients and is designed to assess the Levulan PD's ability to detect bladder cancer against current methods of detection.
The trial is scheduled to begin during the third quarter, following FDA review of the IND application.

The DUSA study follows publications by independent European researchers which reported that ALA PD improved the detection of bladder cancers up to 20 percent during visual inspection of the inside of the bladder by expert urologists, compared to the standard white light examination.
